aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab was founded by Dominic Bonini, who built Village Foodie to find out which food trucks would come to his village. It is a small company, and he runs it himself.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us – HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.hatchgrab: The more food trucks I looked at, the more I thought they deserved better tools: something built for a business that is at a new place every day, not a restaurant with a fixed address. That is why I started HatchGrab.
aboutPage.story.small: It is a small company and I run it myself. If you get in touch, you get an answer from me, not from a support queue.
aboutPage.story.village: I live in a village. Food trucks visit, but I never knew which one would come, or when, without searching around on Facebook.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: So I built Village Foodie, a simple way to see which food trucks are coming to villages near you.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers pre-order for a later date or a later time ahead of the event.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Break down sales by date range, dish and event to see what really sells.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically – you don’t need to confirm each order.

featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Give an order a pager number when you hand out a pager, so you know which pager belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, with order numbers and when the orders are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck shows on HatchGrab’s public map so customers nearby find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each date links straight to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with your own prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to run HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose coverage.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much the kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a time slot is full, customers can’t choose it.

featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine dishes into meal deals and offer extras at checkout to raise the average order.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as the automatic replies on WhatsApp, for questions on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Run several screens – at the counter and in the kitchen – all showing the same orders in real time.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own logins with the right permissions.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose coverage, online ordering pauses, so customers can’t place orders you don’t see. The app for iPhone, iPad and Android lets you keep taking orders offline; the web control panel needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take payment by card in advance when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a last ordering time for dishes that need advance notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A QR code to print that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically – from your website or a photo you already post on Facebook. You just review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers a text when the order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs – we automatically add dates, places and times for each week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any dish as sold out with one tap – it is greyed out for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock level that counts down as orders come in and then sells out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a compatible phone, so you don’t need a separate card reader.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or cable-connected printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time from your time slots, so the rush is spread over the whole service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the serving window, paid with your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatic replies to questions about your menu and your schedule on WhatsApp.

landing.does.capacityBody: Say how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the food truck – and the card reader you already take payment with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, stable wifi and the same opening hours every week. You are at a new place every week, at different times, with poor or no mobile coverage. HatchGrab is built for exactly that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose coverage, online ordering pauses automatically, so customers can’t place orders you don’t see. Keep taking orders with the app for iPhone, iPad and Android.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already use on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in your dates, places and times, ready to share – every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your posts on Facebook and Instagram
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers pre-order, choose a collection time and skip the queue. The food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp replies while you drive to the pitch or stand at the grill, based on your own menu and your schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will reply while you drive to the pitch or stand at the grill. Messenger and Instagram will follow.
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or a screenshot of your menu, and we turn it into a working ordering page you can try in under 60 seconds. Your dishes, your prices. No registration, no card, nothing to install. Take a look and then decide.
